description: The file defines a struct named PaddedLong used for thread-safe, cache line padding to mitigate false sharing in concurrent programming. It includes padding directives, a value field, and methods for atomic operations.

methods.name: VolatileRead
methods.description: Reads the Value field with a memory barrier to prevent instruction reordering.

methods.name: CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Atomically compares the current Value with an expected value and updates it if they match.
